---
name: generate-and-validate
description: Generate application code from specs and validate it passes all tests.
---

1. Follow the instructions in `.github/skills/generate/SKILL.md` to generate the application code.
2. Follow the instructions in `.github/skills/run-tests/SKILL.md` to run the test suite.
3. If any tests fail, fix the code and re-run the tests.
4. Repeat until all tests pass.
